fact: Article 32 of Law No. 2024/017 makes any transfer of personal data abroad subject to the Authority's prior authorisation, which the Authority is to grant after checking adequacy of the destination, a prior legal instrument and standard contractual clauses it will publish; the review is of February 2025 and the Authority was not yet established.
title: Operationalising Cameroon's Data Protection Law: A Review of Key Provisions and Impacts
